extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: classic open-cockpit biplane (two-seat trainer), approx. 8.2 x 9.8 x 3.1 m (L incl. propeller x wingspan x H, parked), propeller diameter 2.5 m
extras.notes: nose faces -Y; parked tail-dragger attitude: stands on both main wheels and the tail wheel (z = 0), nose raised 11.8 degrees; separate moving parts with origin on their axis: biplane_propeller (spins around the tilted engine axis), 2 main wheels and the tail wheel (roll around local X); exposed 9-cylinder radial engine; open cockpits without interior details; no text, no registration, no roundels, no brand

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
